## What you need

- **Must (headline):** AWS / Azure / GCP, GenAI reference architectures, Stakeholder communication.
- **Important (headline):** Leadership & mentoring, GRC & risk assessment, Python (production), Managed AI (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex), Cost & latency engineering, Token & unit economics, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, SSO, Pre-sales.
- **Full inventory:** 56 skills (Must 5 · Important 17 · Should 25 · Optional 9), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-solutions-architect.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-solutions-architect.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Senior engineer / cloud architect background. Certifications (AIP-C01, PMLE, AI-103) are tie-breakers mainly in IT-services, staffing and partner channels [B/C · T0-11]
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) (Optional: tie-breaker in IT services, staffing and partner firms); Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer (PMLE) (Optional: GCP shops); Microsoft AI-103 (Azure AI apps and agents) (Optional: Azure partners; beta). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A reference architecture with a cost model and a working infrastructure-as-code deployment
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P11 Customer pilot / reference architecture with a cost model](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p11) (76%); [P12 AI PM case: PRD, eval rubric, pilot metrics](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p12) (20%); [P6 Self-hosted LLM platform on Kubernetes](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p6) (16%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Application plus customer scoping.** It tests RAG over sensitive, fast-changing documents and evaluating a multi-agent system (the Databricks AI-FDE loop), plus a scoping or customer round. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [application plus customer scoping prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#application-plus-customer-scoping-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).
